style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot grounds, pastel cloud-blue #C9E5EF and cream-yellow #F6E8C8 info grounds, warm light-grey #E3E1DD macro grounds
style.iconSystem: flat pastel paper-cut cloud and sun shapes with thin-line icons, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral studio light, front-left key with fill, gentle wrap, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent pastel childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud blue #C9E5EF, cream yellow #F6E8C8, blush pink plaid accent #E88CA8 and deep navy text #2B3A67 with clean white #FFFFFF packshot grounds; bright soft neutral studio lighting with front-left key, gentle wrap and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; flat pastel paper-cut decorative shapes with thin-line icons; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic cards; stable hero product angle and scale with the garment always neatly pressed and framed above the neckline; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cartoon character prints.
style.presentationRules: garment neatly pressed on a faceless child-size form or hanger, stable hero angle and scale across the set, frame cropped above the neckline
style.surfaceSystem: smooth paper-textured backdrop and light wooden hanger rail
